fflow: flex-flow: column wrap; // shorthand for flex-direction and flex-wrap
jc: justify-content: flex-start; // flex-end | center | space-between | space-around | space-evenly | start | end | left | right ... + safe | unsafe;
ai: align-items: stretch; // flex-start | flex-end | center | baseline | first baseline | last baseline | start | end | self-start | self-end + ... safe | unsafe;
